name: Time Series
description: Time-series analysis over rows ordered by time inside each group_by partition. Mode decompose: centred moving average trend (2 x period for an even period), per-position means of the detrended series normalised to sum to 0 (additive) or average to 1 (multiplicative), residual = observed - trend - seasonal (or observed/(trend*seasonal)); edges without a full window are NULL. Mode acf: autocorrelations for lag 0..max_lag plus the partial autocorrelations from the Durbin-Levinson recursion. Mode lag: the input columns plus value_lag_1..value_lag_max_lag as a lazy SQL plan. Mode forecast: naive, seasonal_naive, mean, drift or additive Holt-Winters (fixed smoothing 0.3/0.1/0.1) for horizon steps; the interval is forecast +/- z(confidence)*sigma*sqrt(h) with sigma the one-step in-sample residual standard deviation (approximation). Mode stationarity: augmented Dickey-Fuller with a constant and one lagged difference; the p-value is a normal approximation fitted to the MacKinnon large-sample critical values (0.10 = -2.57, 0.05 = -2.86, 0.01 = -3.43).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: decompose, acf, lag, forecast or stationarity.

time.title: Time column
time.description: Numeric or date column; rows are ordered by it inside each group.

group_by.title: Group by
group_by.description: Optional columns: one series per group.

period.title: Period
period.description: Seasonal period for decompose and holt_winters, at least 2.

max_lag.title: Max lag
max_lag.description: Highest autocorrelation lag (acf) or the number of lag columns (lag).

method.title: Method
method.description: decompose: additive or multiplicative; forecast: naive, seasonal_naive, mean, drift or holt_winters.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence level of the forecast interval, in (0, 1).

max_rows.title: Max rows
max_rows.description: The series is analysed in memory: at most this many rows are read.
